name: Radiant Reweaving
description: Reweave a ruined soul in radiant light until every thread of the ally gleams as it did at birth.

name: Soulfire Cleansing
description: Burn a curse out of an ally's soul with a pure white fire that spares everything but the stain.

name: Threshold Recall
description: Stand on the threshold of death and haul back an ally whose breath has only just stopped.

name: Sunward Shell
description: Wall a patient in a shell of golden force that no hostile soul strike can pierce.

name: Resplendent Restoration
description: Restore a dying ally's soul in a glorious sustained rite until the glow of the soul outshines the wound.

name: Absolving Wash
description: Wash the whole record of harm and curse from an ally's soul in one absolving rinse.

name: Last Heartbeat
description: Catch the last heartbeat of a newly stopped ally and restart the soul on its echo.

name: Anointed Resolve
description: Anoint an ally's will with the healer's own resolve so the ally rises where others would fall.

name: Everlife Rite
description: The testament's first rite that sets an unfading life in a mended soul with a depth scaled to the healer's reserve.

name: Unfailing Anima
description: The testament's second rite that makes an ally's anima proof against every later wound with a strength scaled to the healer.

name: Sovereign Mercy
description: The testament's third rite in which the healer gives mercy to a soul beyond all hope with a power scaled to the healer's reserve.

name: Hallowed Resurgence
description: Raise every soul that fell within the healer's widest window at once up to the ceiling of the healer's tier.

name: Blow Unmade
description: Erase a wound from an ally's soul as though it was never struck which no mending of force explains and costs the healer years.
